## Reflection summary

This is a short, **private** report on how your team project went: your teammates never see it.
You rate **yourself and each teammate**, and describe what everyone contributed.
We read it alongside your GitHub history to set the team work multiplier
(see [Deliverables](../index.qmd#deliverables) in the syllabus, which also has the due date).

- [ ] Copy the four rating tables and the questions below into a `.qmd` or `.md` file
- [ ] Rate every team member, **including yourself**, from 1 to 4
- [ ] Describe each person's contributions and how the team worked
- [ ] Render it to PDF and submit it on Gradescope

Write it in your own words, and keep your teammates' information out of AI tools
(see the [AI policy](../index.qmd#use-of-generative-ai)).

## 1. Rate each team member

Use this scale for each of the four areas below:

| Rating | Description                             |
|--------|-----------------------------------------|
| 4      | Usually (over 90% of the time)          |
| 3      | Frequently (more often than not)        |
| 2      | Sometimes (less than half the time)     |
| 1      | Rarely (never or once in a great while) |

**Preparation.**
Prepares for meetings; knows the material and the project's goals; does what they say they will do, on time; comes to meetings on time.

**Helps the group excel.**

**Team player (cooperation).**

## 2. Describe the contributions

Briefly (point form is fine), answer:

-   What was **your** role, and what did you do for the project?
-   What were the roles of each of your teammates?
-   How did the team work together? What went well, and what went poorly?

## Submission instructions

Render your file to PDF and submit it on Gradescope.
